swf_open_course.accept_append: The drones that lay the resin work the Crust, south-west of town - not the course itself.

swf_mound_spitters.accept_append: The fence line runs along the Mounds, east of Saltwheel.

swf_mound_queen.accept_append: The Undercrust is a long way south of Saltwheel, under the far edge of the pan.
